newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: New investor set to take over Atlas.
newsitem.headline: New investor set to take over Atlas.

text.p: Atlas Consolidated Mining and Development said on Tuesday a proposed take over by a new investor into the company would be presented to shareholders in its annual meeting tomorrow.

The firm said in a statement shareholders approval would be sought for the increase in Atlas' authorised capital from 150 million shares to 650 million so it will have enough stocks to issue to Minoro Mining and Exploration Corp.
"The plan for the rehabilitation of the Cebu copper mines and the formal takeover by a new group, Minoro, into Atlas is expected to be presented in the annual stockholders' meeting," it said.
Minoro has already reached an agreement in priciple with Atlas' creditors to assume its 3.7-billion peso debt, Atlas said in a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange early this month.
"The assumed debts by Minoro will be converted into equity of Atlas," the statement said.
Some 370 million Atlas shares will be issued to Minoro after it has completed settlement of Atlas' debts.
"The main thrust for the take-over by Minoro of Atlas is to develop its copper orebody and utilise all the existing assets such as buildings, machinery, and mining claims," it added.
